cover_letter:
Dear Go Vocal team,

I'm writing to apply for the Digital Marketer (Demand Gen / Growth Marketing) role. Your mission to reshape digital democracy and empower local communities speaks to me personally. I want to use my marketing skills for work that matters, and Go Vocal's impact across 600+ cities is exactly the kind of purpose I'm looking for.

I'm a digital marketing generalist with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO. At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds for client websites. I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Search Console to guide decisions. On my own project, mirook.com, I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience with AI search visibility aligns with your focus on AI leverage and SEO/AI search visibility.

I'm comfortable with CRM (basic hands-on use at Episto), and I'm quick to learn new tools. I'm particularly excited about your emphasis on AI automation—I've been exploring AI-assisted content tools and am eager to build workflows with n8n, Make, or Zapier to scale demand gen experiments. While I haven't owned a pipeline KPI before, I've shipped SEO and content experiments end to end, from hypothesis to readout, and I'm driven to own outcomes.

I work remotely from Belgium (CET) and am fluent in English. I'd love to bring my curiosity, technical skills, and drive to ship to your growth team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
